visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Memoize the Recursion
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This recursive fib recomputes the same values thousands of times. Add an array that remembers each result. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The plain version makes about 150,000 calls for fib(24) because the same values are computed again and again. With the memo array each value is computed once, so it needs only a few dozen calls.
